blocks.text: Cricket update: England enjoy dominant day at Lord's to close in on series win. England enjoy day of dominance with both bat and ball to put themselves in complete control of the second Test against Pakistan, closing day two on 81-3, giving the hosts a lead of 261 at Lord's.
